statement: In gold, crude and FX futures, the return from the previous day's 15:00 CT close to 09:00 CT (overnight + first US hour) predicts the 09:00-15:00 CT return (continuation). (reversal variant)
mechanism: intraday momentum: late-informed / hedging flows trade in the direction of the early move (Gao, Han, Li & Zhou 2018 equities; Elaut, Froemmel & Lampaert 2018 FX; commodities literature). Never tested in this project on non-equity markets.
falsification: {"DEV": "pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND >= 4/6 markets positive", "VAL": "pooled net Sharpe >= 0.3", "TEST": "net > 0 at 1x and >= 0 at 2x", "FRESH": "pooled net mean > 0 (TopstepX real futures never used by any strategy)"}
